messages:
Mira (Product): FYI I uploaded a mock of the audit log export panel — want quick UX + a11y pass before we freeze copy.
Sam (Design): looking now. overall👍. immediate nit: filter presets are hard to discover. suggest label 'Saved filters' vs 'Presets'?
Matt (Eng): backend note — current export header is `timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days`. Renaming headers will break existing customer parsers. We can emit a header map file though.
Elaine (Security): also need stronger copy around KMS/key metadata export. If an export includes key IDs or key alias we should surface a warning: "Export includes key metadata. Verify export destination meets your compliance requirements."
Aria (A11y): a few keyboard/screen reader nits: 1) filter chips need `role=button` and explicit `aria-pressed` states; 2) preset list must be reachable via keyboard (tab + arrow); 3) when user triggers export, announce "Export started" and progress updates to SR via `aria-live=polite` so NVDA/VoiceOver users know status.
Sam (Design): good catches. Also contrast issue: the small KMS badge (purple lock) at 12px fails AA contrast on hover text. We should either increase size or add a high-contrast variant and not rely on color alone.
Matt (Eng): implementation plan: add an `export_manifest.json` alongside CSV. manifest includes `headers`, `header_aliases` and `export_version`. e.g.
```
Export-Version: 2
headers: timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days
header_aliases: {"retention_period": "retention_days"}
```
We can keep v1 behavior default but emit manifest for v2.
Elaine (Security): +1 on manifest. Also request an optional checkbox for 'Include key metadata' default OFF. If customer checks it, show the copy/warning and require a typed confirmation `I understand` for enterprise accounts.
Mira (Product): checkbox sounds like a good privacy-first default. For non-enterprise we may still show a warning modal.
Aria (A11y): modal needs focus trap and first focus on the confirm field. Also the typed-confirmation should have `aria-describedby` pointing to the security blurb.
Sam (Design): microcopy suggestion for the export button: `Download CSV (includes key metadata)` when the box is checked, otherwise `Download CSV`. Tooltip: `CSV export includes audit log fields; include key metadata only if necessary.`
Matt (Eng): dev impact: small. I'll add header aliasing + manifest and the checkbox flag. ETA for review: end of week. The typed confirm flows will be gated behind a feature flag for enterprise customers.
opsbot: deploy-preview created for `feature/audit-export-a11y` — http://preview/redwood/1234 (auto)
Mira (Product): ok team — owners: Matt for backend changes, Sam for microcopy + visuals, Aria for a11y sign-off, Elaine for security copy. I'll create a follow-up PR checklist. If nobody objects I'll land the copy tweaks tomorrow. :thumbsup:
